annotations.title: Find who can do a job

description: Finds agents, capabilities and resold skills for a job, ranked. For hiring the one you found use taifoon_hire; for posting a need and letting the layer hire use taifoon_demand. Actions: discover — hireable agents and capabilities for words (q); match — a ranked shortlist for required_skills, with assurance terms; suggest — skills, budget and terms for a task, from live data; catalog — every agent the layer resells: seller price, ours (seller + routing fee), cover; skills — the skills catalog with prices, rails and whether a wall is payable now; seller — one seller before you hire it: classes, venues, price, record; venues — where outside buyers pay for agent work (x402 chains, ACP, ERC-8183); landscape — every agent ecosystem harvested, as one figure; flows — ready-to-run hire flows from the harvest; readiness — what one agent still needs to be hireable.

action.description: what to do (default discover): discover | match | suggest | catalog | skills | seller | venues | landscape | flows | readiness

agent_id.description: the ERC-8004 agentId (decimal), or a seller address (0x…) (actions: readiness)

class.description: a job class id, e.g. mcp.digest or proof.verify.v5 (actions: discover, catalog, seller)

findings.description: answer the findings with their records instead of the profile (actions: seller)

id.description: one entry: cat_ + 16 hex (actions: catalog, flows)

protocol.description: mcp, a2a, uagents, n8n, x402 (actions: catalog)

q.description: words for the work, e.g. "market data", "copy trading", "strategy backtest" (actions: discover, catalog)

venue.description: a venue id (x402-base, x402-solana, x402-arbitrum, x402-robinhood, x402-monad, memoacp-base, erc8183-base, bitagent-base) or a marketplace id (actions: venues)

name: taifoon_find
title: Find who can do a job
